# Sample risk report · Energy sector sensitivity

**Review date:** 11 November 2026. **Currency:** INR. **Horizon:** one year. **Data:** 40 fictional facilities generated by the PDF verification fixture. This is a dated extract from the actual report generation run. The dashboard's normal seed portfolio is a different dataset. [Report generation and test record](https://github.com/animeshpthk07/AegisRisk/actions/runs/42971057447/job/130359388471)

## Executive summary

On ₹100,000,000 of exposure, the portfolio's one-year expected loss is ₹1,125,000. Doubling PD and multiplying LGD by 1.2 for Energy increases expected loss to ₹1,912,500. Energy accounts for the full ₹787,500 increase. The assumptions leave EAD unchanged across the portfolio.

| Industry | Facilities | EAD | Baseline EL | Stressed EL | Change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Energy | 20 | ₹50,000,000 | ₹562,500 | ₹1,350,000 | +₹787,500 |
| Technology | 20 | ₹50,000,000 | ₹562,500 | ₹562,500 | ₹0 |
| **Total** | **40** | **₹100,000,000** | **₹1,125,000** | **₹1,912,500** | **+₹787,500 (70%)** |

## Trace one facility

Each facility has ₹2,500,000 EAD, 2.5% supplied PD and 45% LGD. Baseline EL is 0.025 × 0.45 × ₹2,500,000 = ₹28,125 per facility. For an Energy facility the scenario uses 5% PD and 54% LGD, giving ₹67,500. The increase of ₹39,375 across 20 Energy facilities reconciles to ₹787,500.

Each sector holds half the portfolio exposure, giving industry HHI of 0.50. Each of the 40 distinct borrowers holds 2.5%, giving borrower HHI of 0.025. Every facility is in the same geography and rating band, so both of those HHIs are 1.00. Equal facility sizes explain the ties in the contributor ranking.

## Independent model evaluation

These figures come from the model's separate 600-profile synthetic test split, including 173 simulated events. The portfolio calculation above uses the supplied PD. The model's inputs are four fictional financial ratios.

| Estimator | ROC-AUC | Average precision | Brier score |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Constant training event rate | 0.500000 | 0.288333 | 0.205198 |
| Raw logistic regression | 0.907934 | 0.806776 | 0.107621 |
| Calibrated logistic regression | 0.907934 | 0.806776 | 0.107308 |

In this run the sigmoid calibration preserved ranking and slightly lowered the squared probability error. The purpose of this comparison is to show how model quality was evaluated on simulated outcomes. Actual credit performance remains unknown. [Model card methodology](MODEL_LAB.md)

## Reproduce the sample

From an initialized development environment, run the PDF evidence test.

```sh
AEGISRISK_PDF_EVIDENCE_DIR=test-results/pdf pytest apps/api/tests/test_api.py -k test_pdf_visual_evidence
```

It writes the generated baseline and scenario PDFs plus a literal-label fixture to the selected directory. The CI backend job renders those PDFs to page images and retains them in its time-limited artifact. Inputs, formula and scenario assumptions are in the [test fixture](../apps/api/tests/test_api.py). [Development setup](DEVELOPMENT.md)

This fictional check uses a single snapshot, one currency and a simple assumed shock. It demonstrates reconciliation and reporting. It provides no observed default history or validated macroeconomic forecast.
